comments.en:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Read-only inventory of Visual Studio instances, Copilot components and local files.
.DESCRIPTION
Uses the official Setup Configuration client (vswhere), across all products and
prerelease instances. Reads assembly metadata and file counts only; never reads
chat bodies, credentials or account reports. Does not install or configure VS.
Finding an exporter type does not establish that it emitted usage.
#>
comments.zh:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
只读列出 Visual Studio 实例、Copilot 组件及本地文件。
.DESCRIPTION
使用官方 Setup Configuration 客户端 vswhere，覆盖所有产品及预览实例。
只读取程序集元数据和文件数量，不读取对话正文、凭据或账户报告。
不安装或配置 VS。找到导出器类型不能确认实际发出了用量。
#>

comments.en: # This is Microsoft's documented Installer tool location, not a VS IDE
comments.zh: # 这是 Microsoft 文档中的 Installer 工具目录，

comments.en: # installation path. IDE paths come exclusively from vswhere's results.
comments.zh: # IDE 安装目录完全来自 vswhere 的结果。

comments.en: # Do not use -latest, a year range, or a Community-only product selector.
comments.zh: # 不使用 -latest、按年份限制的版本范围或仅 Community 的产品筛选。

comments.en: # The current runtime result is authoritative for this process. VS may have
comments.zh: # 当前运行时结果是本进程的依据。VS 可能继承了不同环境，

comments.en: # inherited a different environment; keep user defaults and both variables as
comments.zh: # 因此分别保留用户默认目录及两个环境变量作为候选，

comments.en: # separate candidates and report only directories that can be inspected.
comments.zh: # 只报告能够检查的目录。

comments.en: // Materialize tar before compression; an external tar/zstd pipe can stall on large Windows archives.
comments.zh: // 先生成完整 tar 再压缩；外部 tar/zstd 管道在大型 Windows 归档上可能停滞。

comments.en: // Restore Unix modes explicitly; tar otherwise applies the extracting user's umask.
comments.zh: // 显式恢复 Unix 权限，否则 tar 会应用解压用户的 umask。

comments.en: // Run from the extraction: Linux AppRun supplies bundled library paths without FUSE.
comments.zh: // 从解压目录运行；Linux AppRun 提供包内依赖库路径，无须 FUSE。

comments.en: // linuxdeploy may adjust ELF library paths; validate the bundled executable itself.
comments.zh: // linuxdeploy 可能调整 ELF 库路径，因此核对包内实际可执行文件。

comments.en: // tauri-build 2.6.3 does not track the ICO input to the Windows resource compiler.
comments.zh: // tauri-build 2.6.3 不追踪 Windows 资源编译器的 ICO 输入文件。

comments.en: # Root package.json cargo commands omit --workspace; default members must include both app and core.
comments.zh: # 根 package.json 的 cargo 命令不带 --workspace；默认成员须同时覆盖 app 与 core。

comments.en: # fs4: available-space checks before backups (V15 consistent backups before migration/cleanup).
comments.zh: # fs4：备份前磁盘剩余空间检查（V15 迁移/清理前一致备份约定）。

comments.en: # flate2: bounded OTLP receiver gzip decompression (V22 decompression-bomb protection).
comments.zh: # flate2：OTLP 接收器 gzip 解压（有界，V22 压缩炸弹防护）。

comments.en: # Edit JSONC by value ranges; unrelated configuration and comments stay intact.
comments.zh: # 按值范围编辑 JSONC；保留其他配置和注释。

comments.en: # ureq: F2 HTTPS GET refresh of models.dev api.json (rustls, no local-data upload, bounded response).
comments.zh: # ureq：F2 在线刷新 HTTPS GET models.dev api.json（rustls、无本地数据外发；响应体有界）。

comments.en: # backup: SQLite Online Backup API for a consistent staged source copy; Kilo read-only source rules.
comments.zh: # backup：使用 SQLite Online Backup API 创建一致的来源暂存副本；遵守 Kilo 只读来源规则。

comments.en: //!   elapsedMs and copilotCredits are separate; credits are not token usage.
comments.zh: //!   `elapsedMs`、`copilotCredits`（credit 非 token 不入账）、

comments.en: //! Replay the entire bounded mutation log on each changed scan; periodic snapshots
comments.zh: //! 增量约定：kv 更新是周期采样快照，不能按行增量拼接——每轮**全量重放**

comments.en: //! cannot be appended as usage increments. Upstream compacts after 1024 entries.
comments.zh: //! （文件经 1024 条压缩有界），事件按 `vscode-chat:<sessionId>:<requestId>`

comments.en: //! Stable vscode-chat:<sessionId>:<requestId> keys skip identical content and replace newer revisions.
comments.zh: //! 键 upsert 幂等（同内容 unchanged，流式计数器增长走 Replace）。

comments.en: // Replay old cursors once to correct source health and daily missing-field counts.
comments.zh: // 解析格式未变；旧游标需重放一次以修正健康状态和日汇总缺字段计数。

comments.en: // Keep existing revision/tracked_events; resetting them could restore an older snapshot.
comments.zh: // 保留既有 revision/tracked_events，不能清空上下文后退回低修订快照。

comments.en: /// Duration/TTFT maximum per turn: 30 days in milliseconds; discard values beyond it.
comments.zh: /// 单 turn 时长/TTFT 合理上限（30 天毫秒）：超出按损坏丢弃。

comments.en: /// Accepted timestamp range in milliseconds.
comments.zh: /// 时间戳合理区间（毫秒）。

comments.en: /// Token values must be within 0..=MAX_TOKEN_VALUE; invalid values become unknown with diagnostics.
comments.zh: /// token 列合理域（0..=MAX_TOKEN_VALUE）；越界置未知并记诊断。

comments.en: /// Resolve mutable references through object-key and array-index path segments.
comments.zh: /// 沿路径段（对象键/数组下标）解析可变引用。

comments.en: /// Set preserves explicit null; only absent v represents JavaScript undefined.
comments.zh: /// Set：显式 null 保留；仅缺失 v 表示 JavaScript undefined。

comments.en: // Reject an out-of-range Set without expanding arrays; the caller diagnoses path failure.
comments.zh: // 越界 Set 未见产生源：不静默扩张，记路径失败由调用方诊断。

comments.en: /// Push resolves the final object key to an array, truncates to start, then appends items.
comments.zh: /// Push：末端按对象键定位数组，先截断到 `start` 长度再追加 items。

comments.en: // The final segment must be a string object key; reject other segment types.
comments.zh: // 最后一个路径段必须是字符串对象键，拒绝其他类型。

comments.en: /// Replay mutations to reconstruct the latest session state.
comments.zh: /// 重放完整 mutation 日志，得到最终会话状态。

comments.en: // A new initial object, including compaction replacement, replaces the entire state.
comments.zh: // 初始（含压缩重写后的新初始）：整体替换状态。

comments.en: /// Selected usage fields from the final request state; exclude message bodies.
comments.zh: /// 只提取重放后请求中的用量字段，不导入消息正文。

comments.en: /// A known token field is required; unknown usage stays absent and credits alone produce no event.
comments.zh: /// 任一 token 字段有值才入账（未知用量不补零；仅 credit 不构成事件）。

comments.en: /// Complete/Cancelled/Failed (1/2/3) are final; Pending/NeedsInput/missing state remains partial.
comments.zh: /// modelState 1/2/3（Complete/Cancelled/Failed）封口；0/4/缺失仍流式。

comments.en: /// Multiple round model IDs leave the turn model unknown; otherwise prefer resolvedModel,
comments.zh: /// 多个轮次模型 ID 不同时，整轮模型保持未知；否则优先 resolvedModel，

comments.en: /// then request modelId without copilot/, then the final round modelId.
comments.zh: /// 其次为去除 copilot/ 前缀的请求 modelId，最后为末轮 modelId。

comments.en: /// Default mapping: last-call input lower bound and whole-turn output.
comments.zh: /// 默认路径映射：input = 末次调用输入（下界）、output = 整 turn 累计。

comments.en: // These input/output scopes cannot establish complete whole-turn total tokens.
comments.zh: // 输入只覆盖末次调用，输出覆盖整轮；两者不能派生整轮总 token。

comments.en: /// Supplied modelTotals input includes cached tokens; derive uncached input and retain output.
comments.zh: /// modelTotals 输入包含缓存，派生未缓存输入；输出按来源值保留。

comments.en: // Replay the full file rather than resuming mutations from an old byte cursor.
comments.zh: // 全量重放约定：不消费旧游标（kv 采样快照不可增量拼接）；游标仅记录

comments.en: // Store consumed bytes only for the framework's unchanged-file shortcut.
comments.zh: // 已读字节供 framework 的无变化短路使用。

comments.en: // Incomplete bounded reads retain the cursor and commit no replay events; retry later.
comments.zh: // 行超限：不推进游标（重放语义下也不提交事件），受控重试。

comments.en: // Missing initial state leaves the file pending instead of reporting success.
comments.zh: // 无初始条目（空/损坏）：等待或下轮重试，不虚报成功。

comments.en: // chatSessions also stores other extensions; only identified Copilot turns belong here.
comments.zh: // chatSessions 是 VS Code 的通用会话库；其他扩展的轮次不能归为 Copilot。

comments.en: // Whole-turn modelTotals produces one observation per model segment with a model-specific key.
comments.zh: // 整轮 modelTotals 按模型段生成用量观察记录，使用带模型段的事件键。

comments.en: // Each identified toolCallRound contributes one observed main-loop call; token usage
comments.zh: // 每条有 ID 的 toolCallRound 计一次已观察到的主循环调用；token 用量

comments.en: // comes from turn observations. User-turn/model-summary row counts do not count underlying calls.
comments.zh: // 由整轮观察记录贡献，用户回合数或模型汇总行数不表示底层调用次数。

comments.en: // Revise selected event fields only, ignoring body changes. A valid complete replay
comments.zh: // 只按所选事件字段调整修订，正文变化不调整；完整且有效的重放

comments.en: // may correct counters downward; partial reads or malformed mutations cannot replace old snapshots.
comments.zh: // 可修正较大的旧计数，未读完的文件或格式错误不能替换旧快照。

comments.en: // Keep history already removed by the source. On policy updates replay retained event fields
comments.zh: // 来源已删除的历史仍保留；规则更新时重新提交已保留的事件字段，

comments.en: // to rebuild their days, without restoring message bodies or expired detail records.
comments.zh: // 重算对应日汇总，不恢复消息正文或已过期明细。

comments.en: // turn_input_incomplete reflects last-call input coverage inherent in this format.
comments.zh: // turn_input_incomplete 表示此格式只能覆盖末次调用输入的限制。

comments.en: // It does not indicate a malformed record or lower source health.
comments.zh: // 它不表示记录损坏，不降低来源健康状态。

comments.en: // Other diagnostics, including invalid lines/tokens, duplicate keys, or missing ownership, degrade health.
comments.zh: // 非法行、token、重复键或缺失归属等其他诊断仍降低健康状态。

comments.en: // Latest snapshot: last-call input and whole-turn output remain separate.
comments.zh: // last-wins：末次调用输入 + 整 turn 累计输出。

comments.en: // Truncate to length 1, removing request_b, then append request_c.
comments.zh: // 截断到长度 1（移除 request_b）再追加 request_c。

comments.en: // Compaction replacement initializes state already containing request_a's final values.
comments.zh: // 压缩重写：新初始行（状态里已含 request_a 最终值）。

comments.en: // A default turn without modelTotals reports only last-call promptTokens and emits
comments.zh: // 默认路径 turn（无 modelTotals）：promptTokens 只覆盖末次调用，产出

comments.en: // turn_input_incomplete as a coverage notice, not a malformed-record diagnostic.
comments.zh: // turn_input_incomplete 覆盖提示。该提示是格式固有限制、非坏记录或对账差异，

comments.en: // This notice keeps source health active instead of marking every normal turn for review.
comments.zh: // 不降级来源健康（否则每个普通 Copilot 会话都会被误标“需核对”）。

comments.en: // One turn observation carries tokens; two rounds count model_call with unknown per-call tokens.
comments.zh: // 一条 turn observation 承载 token；两条 round 计 model_call、逐轮 token 未知。

comments.zh: /// 打开的 attempt 中最后一个已入库样本，持久化至边界事件结束该尝试。

comments.en: /// Persisted sample-replacement state. Rescans reset step/attempt/ordinal/pending counters
comments.zh: /// 持久化样本替换状态；重扫重置 step/attempt/ordinal/pending 计数，

comments.en: /// and replay from the beginning; preserve revision_floor and tracked_keys.
comments.zh: /// 从头重读；保留 revision_floor 与 tracked_keys。

comments.en: /// Higher revisions prevent replay conflicts; tracked keys identify removed attempts.
comments.zh: /// 更高修订号避免重读冲突；键集用于识别消失的尝试。

comments.en: /// Highest emitted source_revision, monotonic across rounds.
comments.zh: /// 已发射的最大 source_revision（跨轮单调）。

comments.en: /// Previously imported attempt keys for identifying removals; preserve across rescans.
comments.zh: /// 上轮已入库的 attempt 键，用于识别消失记录；重扫不重置。

comments.en: /// Number of observed step/start events; zero means no step yet.
comments.zh: /// 已见 step/start 数（0 = 尚无 step）。

comments.en: /// Number of llm/retry-started events within the current step: the attempt index.
comments.zh: /// 当前 step 内已见 llm/retry-started 数（attempt 序号）。

comments.en: /// Samples emitted in the current attempt +1: the next sample ordinal.
comments.zh: /// 当前 attempt 已发射样本数 + 1（下一个样本序号）。

comments.en: /// Last sample of an open attempt, finalized at a boundary event.
comments.zh: /// 打开的 attempt 的最后样本，边界事件将其标为完成。

comments.en: /// Version basis: KnownVersion identifies the documentation format, not a native DSH client version.
comments.zh: /// KnownVersion 仅标识文档格式，不代表原生 DSH 客户端版本已核验。

comments.en: /// Rescan resets replacement counters and retains prior keys and the highest revision.
comments.zh: /// 重扫重置样本替换计数，保留先前键集与最高修订号。

comments.en: /// Restore the saved JSON cursor; invalid state or a rescan starts at the file beginning.
comments.zh: /// 从存储的游标 JSON 还原；重扫或无效时回到文件头。

comments.en: /// Four optional bounded nonnegative i64 usage fields; nonobjects return None.
comments.zh: /// usage 对象四可选字段（i64 非负有界）；非对象返回 None；

comments.en: /// Extra undocumented keys set true; retain mapped fields and diagnose once.
comments.zh: /// 未文档化额外键返回 true（保留已映射字段，一次性诊断）。

comments.en: /// Incrementally scan a historical documentation-format log, called by DshAdapter::scan.
comments.zh: /// 增量扫描一个持久会话日志（统一入口 `DshAdapter::scan` 分派到本实现）。

comments.en: // No native client version field; KnownVersion refers only to session-log-doc-1.
comments.zh: // 没有原生客户端版本字段；KnownVersion 仅指 session-log-doc-1。

comments.en: // Incremental reads begin with previously tracked attempt keys, so append-only files
comments.zh: // 本轮折叠结果中的 attempt 键集：增量续读从上一轮累计集出发（append-only

comments.en: // retain old attempts even without new rows. Rescans rebuild the complete set from empty;
comments.zh: // 下旧 attempt 不因无新行而"消失"）；重扫从头重折则从空集出发

comments.en: // removed keys are the previous set minus the complete rebuilt set.
comments.zh: // （差分 = 上一轮累计集 - 本轮完整折叠结果）。

comments.en: // Build a sample event: streaming samples are Partial; boundary-finalized samples are Final.
comments.zh: // 构造用量样本事件：流式样本为 Partial，边界结束时补发 Final。

comments.en: // No per-event time in the pinned README; observation time limits daily attribution.
comments.zh: // pinned README 未记载逐事件时间字段：使用观察时间，日归属受限。

comments.en: // Finalize an open attempt by re-emitting its last sample as Final with a higher revision;
comments.zh: // 在 attempt 边界将最后一个样本补发为 Final，使用更高修订号

comments.en: // with no pending sample, only advance the boundary.
comments.zh: // 替换旧值；没有待结束样本时只推进边界。

comments.en: // Step boundary: finalize the current attempt and start a new step with attempt index zero.
comments.zh: // 步边界：结束当前 attempt，进入新 step，attempt 序号归零。

comments.en: // Retry boundary: finalize the current attempt and start another within the same step,
comments.zh: // retry 边界：结束当前 attempt，在同一步内开启新尝试，

comments.en: // with a separate key and independently counted usage.
comments.zh: // 使用独立键，单独统计用量。

comments.en: // An assistant/message without usage produces no event;
comments.zh: // 无 usage 的 assistant/message：未记录用量，不产事件

comments.en: // record a one-time diagnostic and retain other readable data.
comments.zh: // （一次性诊断；部分可用）。

comments.en: // Import streaming/final samples in the same attempt immediately as Partial. Sample ordinal plus
comments.zh: // 同 attempt 的流式/最终样本：立即入账 Partial，样本序号 +

comments.en: // revision_floor gives higher revisions, so Replace removes earlier contributions.
comments.zh: // revision_floor 构成单调修订号 ⇒ 后续样本 Replace 撤销旧贡献。

comments.en: // contextPressure (pressureTokens/projectedTokens/contextWindow)
comments.zh: // 上下文估算 contextPressure（pressureTokens/projectedTokens/contextWindow）

comments.en: // is estimated context size; exclude it from usage and diagnose once.
comments.zh: // 是估算/预测，不进入用量（一次性诊断可见）。

comments.en: // Skip documented events without usage meaning.
comments.zh: // 文档化非用量事件：无用量语义，跳过。

comments.en: // After a complete rescan, previously imported attempts missing from the rebuilt set
comments.zh: // 完整重扫后，之前已入库而本轮键集中消失的 attempt

comments.en: // receive Corrected/Excluded records to remove old contributions and avoid counting rewritten files twice.
comments.zh: // 产生 Corrected/Excluded 记录，撤销旧贡献，防止改写文件后重复计数。

comments.en: // Update tracked keys only at end-of-file; interrupted bounded reads do not identify removals.
comments.zh: // 仅在完整读到文件尾时更新差分基（达到读取上限而中断不做差分判断）。

comments.en: // Reject undocumented types: clear this round's events, retain the checkpoint, and reject again next round.
comments.zh: // fail closed：本轮事件清空、游标不推进（不提交 checkpoint），下轮确定性再拒。

comments.en: // Old or empty contexts restore with revision_floor=0 and an empty tracked-key set.
comments.zh: // 旧或空上下文恢复时 revision_floor=0，先前键集为空。

comments.en: //! Actual npm rc.2 persistence/LLM/token-meter codecs; see m3-runtime-samples.md.
comments.zh: //! 实际 npm rc.2 的保存、LLM 和 token-meter 编解码；见 m3-runtime-samples.md。

comments.en: //! Only a complete bounded snapshot commits. Native settlement copies are folded once.
comments.zh: //! 仅完整且符合读取限制的快照可提交。原生 settlement 副本只合并一次。

comments.en: // Exact vocabulary from the installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-session generated catalog.
comments.zh: // 枚举值来自已安装 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session 生成的完整列表。

comments.en: // Inherited rows establish lifecycle coordinates, but never local usage.
comments.zh: // 继承行用于确定生命周期位置，不计为本机用量。

comments.en: // A settlement without reported usage does not overwrite a prior sample.
comments.zh: // 未报告用量的 settlement 不覆盖此前样本。

comments.en: // It still establishes an observed attempt when no sample exists.
comments.zh: // 没有此前样本时，它仍记录一次已观测尝试。

comments.en: //! Common adapter interface: discover, detect, scan, map and capability,
comments.zh: //! 适配器框架：discover → detect → scan → map → capability 统一接口，

comments.en: //! with a runner feeding M1 commit_batch. V12: repeated reads do not duplicate usage.
comments.zh: //! 以及把扫描结果接入 M1 `commit_batch` 管线的运行器（V12：重复扫描不增量）。

comments.en: //! Rules:
comments.zh: //! 规则要点：

comments.en: //! - discover: bounded candidate paths, environment overrides and manual roots; no full-disk scan;
comments.zh: //! - discover：候选路径 + 环境覆盖 + 手工根，有界枚举，不全盘扫描；

comments.en: //! - detect: file signatures, record types and schema fingerprints, with per-Agent version registries;
comments.zh: //! - detect：文件 magic/记录类型/schema 指纹 + Agent 目录版本注册表分派；

comments.en: //!   unknown/missing versions try the latest built-in Agent reader with compatibility metadata (V17/V30);
comments.zh: //!   未知/缺失版本默认尝试该 Agent 最新内置解析器并带兼容标记（V17/V30），

comments.en: //!   verified incompatible versions and unknown formats remain restricted;
comments.zh: //!   已确认不兼容的版本与未知格式 fail closed 返回受限；

comments.en: //! - scan: incremental JSONL cursors keep file identity, generation, complete-line byte offset and parse context;
comments.zh: //! - scan：增量游标读取（JSONL 游标 = 文件身份 + generation + 完整行字节偏移 + 解析上下文）；

comments.en: //! - capability: declare the fields available from each source;
comments.zh: //! - capability：每源字段能力声明，供未来数据源页使用；

comments.en: //! - diagnostics keep field names, error codes and positions without copying raw content.
comments.zh: //! - 诊断只存字段名/错误码/位置，不复制原始内容。

comments.en: /// Default wall-clock timeout for one source run: 30 seconds (architecture.md).
comments.zh: /// 单源每轮墙钟超时初值（architecture.md：30 秒）。

comments.en: /// Discovery file/directory limits.
comments.zh: /// 发现阶段的文件/目录上界（有界探测）。

comments.en: /// Transient detection I/O: short antivirus/product locks, Windows sharing violations
comments.zh: /// detect 入口的瞬态 IO 错误判定：杀软/产品进程短暂持锁

comments.en: /// mapped to PermissionDenied, timeouts or files deleted after enumeration.
comments.zh: /// （Windows 共享违例 → PermissionDenied）、超时、枚举后文件被清理。

comments.en: /// Return Pending and retry next run instead of persisting a scan failure or UnknownFormat.
comments.zh: /// 瞬态错误必须 Pending 下轮重探，不能固化为扫描失败或 UnknownFormat。

comments.en: /// Read a detection header; Ok(None) means transiently unreadable and requires Pending.
comments.zh: /// detect 文件头读取助手：`Ok(None)` = 瞬态不可读（调用方返回 Pending）；

comments.en: /// Propagate other errors as CoreError.
comments.zh: /// 硬错误上抛 CoreError。

comments.en: /// Discovery context: an explicit environment map supports isolated tests without process-environment reads.
comments.zh: /// 发现上下文。环境变量以显式 map 传入，便于测试且不依赖真实进程环境。

comments.en: /// How a candidate root was selected.
comments.zh: /// 候选根的来源依据。

comments.en: /// Environment override; the stored string is the variable name, not its value.
comments.zh: /// 环境变量覆盖（值是变量名，不是内容）。

comments.en: /// Platform default user directory.
comments.zh: /// 平台默认用户目录。

comments.en: /// User-added manual root.
comments.zh: /// 用户手工添加的根。

comments.en: /// Candidate root with bounded file enumeration.
comments.zh: /// 一个有界枚举后的候选根。

comments.en: /// Detection results follow architecture.md compatibility rules:
comments.zh: /// 格式探测结果（architecture.md 未知版本兼容约定）：

comments.en: /// - Supported: verified Agent identity/input type; known versions dispatch through the registry.
comments.zh: /// - Supported：Agent 身份与输入类型已确认。已知版本按注册表映射分派（KnownVersion）；

comments.en: ///   Unknown/missing versions select LatestFallback and retain compatibility metadata.
comments.zh: ///   未知/缺失版本默认选择该 Agent 最新内置解析器（LatestFallback），结果须带兼容标记。

comments.en: /// - UnsupportedVersion: verified incompatibility, such as a different source format; no fallback.
comments.zh: /// UnsupportedVersion：已确认版本不兼容，例如固定源码中的格式不同；不尝试回退。

comments.en: /// - UnknownFormat: unverified Agent/format stays restricted instead of reporting successful zero records (V17).
comments.zh: /// - UnknownFormat：Agent 身份或格式无法确认，fail closed；不得返回“成功 0 条”（V17）。

comments.en: /// Native version, or None when absent; LatestFallback remains possible.
comments.zh: /// 来源原始版本；版本字段缺失时为 None（仍可 LatestFallback）。

comments.en: /// No classifiable content yet, such as an empty new file; retry next run.
comments.zh: /// 文件尚无可判定内容（如新建空文件）：下轮重探。

comments.en: /// Availability of one capability.
comments.zh: /// 单项能力可用性。

comments.en: /// Structured discovery, detection, mapping, incremental, deduplication, coverage, maintenance and scheduling capabilities.
comments.zh: /// 结构化能力声明（发现/探测/映射/增量/去重/完整性/维护/定时/限制）。

comments.en: /// Token/cache/call/model/time/cost/latency field availability.
comments.zh: /// 字段能力：token/缓存读/缓存写/逐次请求/模型/时间/费用/延迟。

comments.en: /// One file to scan.
comments.zh: /// 逐文件扫描目标。

comments.en: /// Normalized local file path; store locally and exclude from external output.
comments.zh: /// 规范化后的文件路径（只进本地库，不进对外输出）。

comments.en: /// source_files.file_id, based on the normalized path.
comments.zh: /// source_files.file_id（规范化路径字符串）。

comments.en: /// source_files.file_identity/checkpoint scope_key, stable across supported renames.
comments.zh: /// source_files.file_identity / checkpoint scope_key（跨改名稳定）。

comments.en: /// Current observed file state.
comments.zh: /// 探测到的当前文件状态。

comments.en: /// Generation selected by file-continuity rules; a rescan already uses the new value.
comments.zh: /// 按文件续读规则确定的 generation；重扫时已使用新值。

comments.en: /// Whether replacement, truncation or rebuilding requires a scan from the beginning.
comments.zh: /// 本次是否从头重扫（替换/截断/重建）。

comments.en: /// Stored cursor and parse context.
comments.zh: /// 已存储的扫描状态（游标 + 解析上下文）。

comments.en: /// Scan limits.
comments.zh: /// 扫描限制。

comments.en: /// File scan status.
comments.zh: /// 逐文件扫描状态。

comments.en: /// Reached the current end of file.
comments.zh: /// 读到当前文件尾。

comments.en: /// Read/time limit reached; preserve a complete-line cursor and continue next run.
comments.zh: /// 达到读取上限或超时，游标停在完整行边界，下轮继续。

comments.en: /// Oversized line: restrict reading at its start and permit a controlled retry.
comments.zh: /// 某行超过单行上限：受限，游标停在该行起点，允许受控重试。

comments.en: /// Empty file awaiting content.
comments.zh: /// 空文件等待内容。

comments.en: /// Snapshot reconciliation with selected numeric fields, without message content.
comments.zh: /// 快照比较结果，仅含选定的数值字段，不含消息正文。

comments.en: /// Series label, such as session_cumulative_snapshot, without IDs/paths.
comments.zh: /// 系列标签（如 "session_cumulative_snapshot"），不含 ID/路径。

comments.en: /// Sum of detailed total_tokens values.
comments.zh: /// 逐次明细的 total_tokens 合计。

comments.en: /// Final cumulative snapshot value.
comments.zh: /// 最终累计快照值。

comments.en: /// Sum of boundary records excluded by verified rules, such as compaction-carried usage.
comments.zh: /// 按已核验规则排除的边界记录合计（如 compaction 携带记录）。

comments.en: /// Difference: detail_sum - (snapshot_final + carried_sum).
comments.zh: /// 差值为 detail_sum - (snapshot_final + carried_sum)。

comments.en: /// Reconciliation verdict: matched, mismatch or no_snapshot.
comments.zh: /// 比较结果为 matched、mismatch 或 no_snapshot。

comments.en: /// One scan result.
comments.zh: /// 一次扫描的产出。

comments.en: /// Source-file health: active or degraded.
comments.zh: /// 源文件健康（active / degraded）。

comments.en: /// Common adapter interface.
comments.zh: /// 适配器统一接口。

comments.en: /// Agent name used by statistics and event.agent.
comments.zh: /// 统计归属的 Agent 名（事件 agent 字段）。

comments.en: /// Bounded discovery through candidate paths, environment overrides and manual roots.
comments.zh: /// 有界发现：候选路径 + 环境覆盖 + 手工根；不全盘扫描。

comments.en: /// Opt in only when files can be visited independently of discovery order.
comments.zh: /// 仅文件访问不依赖发现顺序时，才启用轮换读取。

comments.en: /// Stable local instance ID for a candidate root.
comments.zh: /// 由候选根得到稳定的本机实例 ID。

comments.en: /// Detect file signature/record type/schema; use the per-Agent registry for version selection.
comments.zh: /// 探测文件标记、记录类型和 schema；按各 Agent 注册表选择版本读取器。

comments.en: /// Incrementally scan one supported file.
comments.zh: /// 增量扫描一个已支持的文件。

comments.en: /// Recheck consumed, unchanged files while preserving monotonic revisions in cursor context.
comments.zh: /// 重新检查已消费且字节未变化的文件，同时保留游标上下文中的单调修订。

comments.en: /// Skip by default; snapshot adapters can opt in for a one-time statistics/health rule correction.
comments.zh: /// 默认继续跳过；快照适配器可用于一次性的统计/健康规则修正。

comments.en: /// Update file compatibility from per-record checks, committing it with events and cursors.
comments.zh: /// 按逐记录检查更新文件级兼容状态，与事件和游标一起提交。

comments.en: /// Structured capability declaration.
comments.zh: /// 结构化能力声明。

comments.en: /// Complete prior hashes for explicitly verified parser corrections only.
comments.zh: /// 仅明确核对过的解析修正可使用完整旧摘要的哈希。

comments.en: /// Require the same source revision; unrelated field changes still conflict.
comments.zh: /// 来源修订必须相同；其他字段变化仍按冲突处理。

comments.en: /// A verified archive may replace file scanning for this root.
comments.zh: /// 已核对的归档可替代本根目录的文件扫描。

comments.en: /// Keep errors visible without silently adding counts from a second data format.
comments.zh: /// 保留可见错误，不悄然叠加第二种数据格式的用量。

comments.en: /// Normalize separators and remove the Windows verbatim prefix for local identity.
comments.zh: /// 规范化路径字符串（统一分隔符并去除 Windows verbatim 前缀；仅用于本地身份）。

comments.en: /// Enumerate bounded depth/file/directory counts without following symlinks.
comments.zh: /// 有界目录枚举：深度受限、不跟随符号链接、文件数/目录数有上限。

comments.en: /// Rotate bounded file windows using persisted visits; unvisited files go first.
comments.zh: /// 按已保存的访问记录轮换有限文件集，优先读取尚未访问的文件。

comments.en: /// Equal visits retain the adapter's discovery order. Only committed file rows
comments.zh: /// 访问时间相同则保留适配器的发现顺序，仅已提交的文件行

comments.en: /// count as visits, so a rolled-back read keeps its place for the next run.
comments.zh: /// 计为已访问，因此事务回滚后的读取仍保留下一轮的位置。

comments.en: /// source_instances registration input; preserve user settings such as enabled during conflict updates.
comments.zh: /// source_instances 注册输入。enabled 等用户设置在冲突更新时保留。

comments.en: /// Verified local collection supplies origin_host_id; None denotes legacy_unknown ownership.
comments.zh: /// origin_host_id：本机核验采集传入本地主机 ID；None 表示未区分（legacy_unknown）。

comments.en: /// Preserve sources owned by another host; verified local collection may claim legacy_unknown sources
comments.zh: /// 已属于其他主机的来源不被覆盖；legacy_unknown 来源可被本机核验采集认领

comments.en: /// when file locality and ownership mapping are verified (data-contract.md#provenance).
comments.zh: /// （文件就在本机且 locality 已核验 = 可证明映射，data-contract.md#provenance）。

comments.en: /// Source host ownership (M1a); None uses the legacy_unknown namespace.
comments.zh: /// 来源归属主机（M1a）；None → legacy_unknown 命名空间。

comments.en: /// Historical namespace for databases before v4 host ownership.
comments.zh: /// 迁移前的历史来源命名空间（v4 前未记录主机身份）。

comments.en: /// source_files row used for registration, rename and replacement detection.
comments.zh: /// source_files 行（注册与改名/替换探测用）。

comments.en: /// Detection JSON: native version, selected format/parser, selection basis and compatibility (v3 column).
comments.zh: /// 探测结论（JSON）：原始版本、所选格式/parser、选择依据、兼容状态（v3 列）。

comments.en: /// Find by file identity: a supported rename preserves the content stream while changing its path.
comments.zh: /// 按文件身份查找（改名探测：内容流身份稳定，路径可变）。

comments.en: /// Load cursor and parse context from the checkpoint.
comments.zh: /// 读取检查点（游标 + 解析上下文）。

comments.en: /// Build StoredFileState from source_files for file-continuity checks.
comments.zh: /// 由 source_files 行构造 StoredFileState，供文件续读检查使用。

comments.en: /// Configuration for one collection run.
comments.zh: /// 一次源采集运行的配置。

comments.en: /// Run/batch ID prefix, with the instance sequence appended.
comments.zh: /// 运行/批次 ID 前缀；实际 ID 追加实例序号。

comments.en: /// Local source-host ID (M1a); None denotes legacy_unknown ownership.
comments.zh: /// 采集归属的本机来源主机 ID（M1a）；None 表示未区分（legacy_unknown）。

comments.en: /// The application obtains it through Storage::ensure_local_host.
comments.zh: /// 由应用层经 `Storage::ensure_local_host` 取得后传入。

comments.en: /// Per-file run report.
comments.zh: /// 逐文件运行报告。

comments.en: /// Per-instance run report.
comments.zh: /// 逐实例运行报告。

comments.en: /// Discover and detect/scan each file, then commit the instance in one transaction (V12).
comments.zh: /// 运行一个适配器：发现 → 逐文件探测/扫描 → 单事务提交（V12 语义）。

comments.en: /// Return instance reports; isolate file failures and mark an unsuccessful instance commit failed.
comments.zh: /// 返回逐实例报告；单文件失败不中断其他文件，实例提交失败标 failed。

comments.en: //! Gemini session JSON parser: session_doc1, documented format session-doc-1.
comments.zh: //! Gemini 会话 JSON 格式实现（`session_doc1`，文档级 session-doc-1）。

comments.en: //! Documented format references (A10):
comments.zh: //! 格式依据（官方文档，A10）：

comments.en: //! - Path: ~/.gemini/tmp/<project_hash>/chats/session-<date>T<time>-<hash>.json.
comments.zh: //! - 路径：`~/.gemini/tmp/<project_hash>/chats/session-<date>T<time>-<hash>.json`

comments.en: //!   One JSON document, not JSONL; no documented environment override.
comments.zh: //!   （单文件 JSON，非 JSONL；无文档化环境覆盖）。

comments.en: //! - Root fields: sessionId, projectHash, startTime, lastUpdated, and messages[].
comments.zh: //! - 顶层 `{sessionId, projectHash, startTime, lastUpdated, messages[]}`；

comments.en: //!   The documented session format includes token usage statistics.
comments.zh: //!   文档中会话格式包含 token 用量统计。

comments.en: //! - Telemetry gemini_cli.token.usage types: input, output, thought, cache, tool.
comments.zh: //! - 遥测 gemini_cli.token.usage 类型为 input/output/thought/cache/tool。

comments.en: //!   api_response has input/output/cached_content/thoughts/tool/total_token_count
comments.zh: //!   `api_response` 六字段 input/output/cached_content/thoughts/tool/total

comments.en: //!   plus model and duration_ms; this parser does not ingest that telemetry.
comments.zh: //!   _token_count + model + duration_ms（telemetry 侧，未接入）。

comments.en: //! - Message tokens fields input/output/cached/thoughts/tool/total are optional.
comments.zh: //! - 消息 token 形状按文档分类实现：`tokens{input, output, cached, thoughts, tool,

comments.en: //!   Inclusion of thoughts, cached, and tool in input/output has not been checked.
comments.zh: //!   total}` 各自可选；thoughts/cached/tool 与 input/output 的包含关系未核验

comments.en: //!   Read only reported totals; do not add thoughts/tool to other token fields.
comments.zh: //!   （未知不猜：total 只取直报，thoughts/tool 不并入任何字段）。

comments.en: //! Read whole rewritten JSON within a 32 MiB limit. Store consumed bytes so the framework
comments.zh: //! 增量语义（整写 JSON）：全量有界读取（32 MiB 初值）；游标存已消费字节数复用

comments.en: //! skips unchanged files; content rewrites/truncation change generation and restart reads.
comments.zh: //! 框架无变化短路；改写/截断走 generation 重扫，事件按稳定身份 upsert 幂等；

comments.en: //! Stable event identities prevent duplicate inserts. Parse failure leaves the cursor unchanged.
comments.zh: //! 半程写入（parse 失败）不推进游标，下轮确定性重试。

comments.en: //! Reject an entire file for undocumented message types or user messages carrying tokens (V17).
comments.zh: //! fail closed（V17）：未文档化消息 type、或 user 消息携带 tokens，整文件拒绝

comments.en: //! Leave the cursor unchanged so subsequent scans retry the same file without guessing its format.
comments.zh: //! （游标不推进、下轮确定性再拒），不猜格式。

comments.en: //! No client-version field selects another implementation. Event parse_basis is KnownVersion
comments.zh: //! 无版本字段可分派：事件 [`EventInput::parse_basis`] 恒为 KnownVersion

comments.en: //! for this documented format, the only registered format; this does not verify native releases.
comments.zh: //! KnownVersion 表示已登记的文档格式，这是当前唯一格式，不表示已核对原生客户端版本。

comments.en: //! M2/V30 moved the implementation from root-level gemini.rs without changing its behavior.
comments.zh: //! M2 目录化迁移（V30）自根级 gemini.rs 原样迁入。

comments.en: /// Whole-file read limit, initially 32 MiB.
comments.zh: /// 单文件有界读取上限（初值 32 MiB）。

comments.en: /// Documented message types; unverified info/error/warning shapes are rejected.
comments.zh: /// 文档化消息类型（info/error/warning 等真实存在但未文档化 ⇒ fail closed 待扩）。

comments.en: /// Six optional token fields; inclusion is unverified, so totals use only reported values.
comments.zh: /// 消息 tokens 六键（各自可选；包含关系未核验，total 只取直报）。

comments.en: /// Parse six optional token fields; present values must be nonnegative and bounded.
comments.zh: /// 解析消息 tokens 六可选字段；存在的值必须非负有界（违例 None，调用方记诊断）。

comments.en: /// Invalid fields reject the token object; extra keys are flagged while known fields remain.
comments.zh: /// 未知额外键返回 true（保留已映射字段，每轮一次性诊断）。

comments.en: /// Whole-document cursor stores consumed bytes and line_number=1 in the shared cursor shape.
comments.zh: /// 整写 JSON 游标：复用框架 JsonlCursor 形状（offset=已消费字节数，line_number 恒 1），

comments.en: /// The unchanged-file shortcut compares probe.len with cursor.offset.
comments.zh: /// 无变化短路依赖 probe.len == cursor.offset。

comments.en: /// Scan one session JSON document, dispatched by GeminiAdapter::scan.
comments.zh: /// 增量扫描一个会话 JSON 文件（统一入口 `GeminiAdapter::scan` 分派到本实现；

comments.en: /// This documented format has one implementation and no client-version dispatch.
comments.zh: /// 唯一格式实现，无版本分派）。

comments.en: // Oversized files retain their starting cursor and return a limited result for retry.
comments.zh: // 超限：受限，游标停在起点，受控重试（不静默丢弃）。

comments.en: // Partially written JSON fails parsing without advancing the cursor; retry next scan.
comments.zh: // 半程写入：parse 失败不推进游标，下轮确定性重试（暂态，非降级）。

comments.en: // Reject the file: clear events, retain the cursor, and report degraded health for retry.
comments.zh: // fail closed 出口：事件清空、游标不推进、degraded，下轮确定性再拒。

comments.en: // Gemini messages without tokens report no usage and produce no event.
comments.zh: // gemini 消息无 tokens：未记录用量，不产事件。

comments.en: // KnownVersion identifies the registered documented format, not a native client release.
comments.zh: // KnownVersion 表示已登记的文档格式，不表示原生客户端版本已核对。

comments.zh: /// jcode 缓存字段语义（provider 原样保留）：

comments.en: /// - openai: input is total, with cache subsets; derive uncached input by subtraction.
comments.zh: /// - openai：input 是总量，cache 读/写为子集 ⇒ uncached 减法派生；

comments.en: /// - anthropic: independent buckets; uncached=input and derived total=sum of all three.
comments.zh: /// - anthropic：三列互斥 ⇒ uncached=input，input_total=三列之和（派生）；

comments.en: /// - Other/unknown providers: preserve fields without assuming inclusion or deriving totals.
comments.zh: /// - 其他/未知：包含关系未知 ⇒ 并列报告不派生。

comments.en: /// One message merged from the snapshot or a journal append.
comments.zh: /// 一条合并后的消息（快照或 journal append）。

comments.en: // Pair the snapshot with its same-stem journal sidecar.
comments.zh: // 快照 + journal sidecar（同 stem）。

comments.en: // Start with snapshot metadata and apply journal overrides in order.
comments.zh: // 元数据：快照值 + journal 逐条覆盖（最后一条 journal 为准）。

comments.en: // Unread journal pages mean incomplete tail coverage; do not return Complete.
comments.zh: // journal 未读完（行数/超时时间或超限行）：尾部消息缺失，不能报

comments.en: // Resume after this page, then restart from the head after reaching the final page
comments.zh: // Complete。分页游标从本轮末尾续读；读到末页后下一轮从头

comments.en: // so changed session metadata can revise events from earlier pages.
comments.zh: // 重读，以便会话级 meta 更新能修订前页事件。

comments.en: // For duplicate IDs in the crash window, prefer the later journal message.
comments.zh: // 崩溃窗口中出现相同 ID 时，优先使用后写入的日志消息。

comments.en: // Missing assistant token_usage remains unknown; do not fill it with zero.
comments.zh: // 无 token_usage 的 assistant 消息：按官方规则保持未知，不补零。

comments.en: // StoredMessage.id is required by the source type; skip missing IDs with a diagnostic.
comments.zh: // StoredMessage.id 是必填字段（官方类型）：缺失按格式偏离跳过记诊断。

comments.en: // Iteration visits the journal first, so it replaces a snapshot message with the same ID.
comments.zh: // journal 覆盖快照的同 id 消息：取 journal 版（先迭代）。

comments.en: // Source timestamp identifies message completion, as described by storage_types.
comments.zh: // timestamp 是消息完成时刻（官方 storage_types 注释）。

comments.en: // Journal meta.updated_at identifies session saving; later corrections need not
comments.zh: // journal meta.updated_at 是会话保存时间；消息完成时间不会随

comments.en: // change message completion timestamps. Ingest retains conflicts without a newer revision.
comments.zh: // 后续同 id 更正必然变化。缺失修订依据时由 ingest 保留冲突。

comments.en: //! Bounded JSONL reader (V07).
comments.zh: //! 有界 JSONL 读取器（V07）。

comments.en: //! Incremental input rules in architecture.md:
comments.zh: //! 约定（architecture.md「各输入的增量策略」）：

comments.en: //! - cursors keep file identity, generation, complete-line byte offset and parse context;
comments.zh: //! - 游标 = 文件身份 + generation + 完整行字节偏移 + 解析上下文；

comments.en: //! - default line limit 8 MiB and chunk size 4 MiB; assemble lines across chunks;
comments.zh: //! - 默认单行上限 8 MiB、单块 4 MiB（允许跨块组装行）；超限不静默丢弃，

comments.en: //!   report oversized positions/reasons without silent dropping, and permit controlled retries;
comments.zh: //!   状态显示位置与原因，允许受控重试；

comments.en: //! - leave incomplete lines for the next run without advancing cursors; assemble UTF-8 and skip its BOM;
comments.zh: //! - 半行留待下次（游标不前移）；跨块 UTF-8 正确组装；跳过 UTF-8 BOM；

comments.en: //! - isolate invalid lines with error codes/line numbers/byte offsets, without copying raw content;
comments.zh: //! - 坏行隔离：诊断只存错误码与位置（行号/字节偏移），不复制原始行内容；

comments.en: //! - detect truncation, same-size replacement and rename; file length alone does not establish continuity.
comments.zh: //! - 截断/同大小替换/改名时重探测；变更检测不限于文件长度。

comments.en: /// Default line limit: 8 MiB.
comments.zh: /// 单行上限初值 8 MiB。

comments.en: /// Default chunk size: 4 MiB.
comments.zh: /// 单块上限初值 4 MiB。

comments.en: /// Bytes sampled at each end for content fingerprints.
comments.zh: /// 身份采样字节数（首/尾各取这么多做内容指纹）。

comments.en: /// max_lines is a deterministic line limit for tests and controlled retries;
comments.zh: /// 读取限制。`max_lines` 是确定性行数上限（测试与受控重试用）；

comments.en: /// time_budget is a wall-clock timeout, defaulting to 30 seconds per source run.
comments.zh: /// `time_budget` 是墙钟超时（单源每轮 30 秒初值）。

comments.en: /// Complete line with byte positions; end is the offset after its terminator.
comments.zh: /// 一条完整行（含字节位置；`end` 为行终止符之后的偏移）。

comments.en: /// Invalid-line diagnostic without message content.
comments.zh: /// 坏行诊断（无正文）。

comments.en: /// Why reading stopped.
comments.zh: /// 读取停止原因。

comments.en: /// Reached the current end of file.
comments.zh: /// 读到当前文件尾。

comments.en: /// Oversized complete line: keep its start as the cursor and permit retry with a higher limit.
comments.zh: /// 某完整行超过单行上限：游标停在该行起点，可受控重试（提高上限）。

comments.en: /// Reached the configured line/byte limit.
comments.zh: /// 达到确定性行数或字节上限。

comments.en: /// Reached the wall-clock timeout.
comments.zh: /// 达到墙钟超时时间。

comments.en: /// Incremental read result.
comments.zh: /// 一次增量读取的结果。

comments.en: /// Next unread offset, after the last complete line; incomplete lines do not advance it.
comments.zh: /// 下一 unread 偏移（最后一条完整行之后；半行不前移）。

comments.en: /// Next line number, starting at one.
comments.zh: /// 下一行号（1 起始）。

comments.en: /// Incomplete bytes retained for the next read.
comments.zh: /// 半行字节数（留待下次）。

comments.en: /// Read from a complete-line start_offset; first_line_number identifies that position.
comments.zh: /// 从 `start_offset`（完整行边界）读取 JSONL。`first_line_number` 为该偏移处的行号。

comments.en: // At offset zero, skip the BOM as line content while retaining it in byte offsets.
comments.zh: // 起点为 0 时跳过 BOM；BOM 不计入行内容但计入字节偏移。

comments.en: // EOF leaves carry as an incomplete line for the next run.
comments.zh: // EOF：carry 中的残余是半行，留待下次。

comments.en: // Split complete lines by byte: 0x0A cannot occur within a UTF-8 multibyte sequence.
comments.zh: // 逐条提取完整行；0x0A 不会出现在 UTF-8 多字节序列内，按字节切分安全。

comments.en: // Incomplete data above the line limit is already oversized; do not wait for further growth.
comments.zh: // 无换行符的残余：若已超过单行上限，同样按超长行处理（不等待它继续增长）。

comments.en: /// Probe length, mtime, creation time and prefix/suffix fingerprints, not length alone.
comments.zh: /// 文件身份探测：长度、mtime、创建时间与首/尾采样指纹。变更检测不限于长度。

comments.en: /// Prefix fingerprint for head_len sampled bytes.
comments.zh: /// 首采样指纹（采样长度 `head_len`）。

comments.en: /// Prefix length: 4096 for larger files, otherwise current length; changed lengths are not comparable.
comments.zh: /// 首采样长度：len >= 4096 时固定 4096；小文件为当前长度（增长后不可比）。

comments.en: /// Stored source_files state and cursor.
comments.zh: /// 已存储的扫描状态（source_files 行 + 游标）。

comments.en: /// Prefix hashes are not comparable when sample lengths differ, such as a growing small file.
comments.zh: /// 首采样长度：与探测值不一致时首指纹不可比（小文件增长跨过采样边界）。

comments.en: /// Decide whether file continuity permits resuming or requires a new generation.
comments.zh: /// 判断文件能否续读，或是否需创建新的文件 generation。

comments.en: /// Same generation: resume from the cursor for unchanged or appended content.
comments.zh: /// 同一 generation：未变化或仅追加内容时从游标继续。

comments.en: /// Replacement/truncation/rebuilding requires generation+1, a full reread and discarded parse context.
comments.zh: /// 文件被替换/截断/重建：generation+1 从头重扫，解析上下文作废。

comments.en: /// Compare stored/probed state: changed creation time indicates a recreated file;
comments.zh: /// 比较存储状态与当前探测。身份要点：创建时间变化 → 新文件；

comments.en: /// length below the cursor means truncation; comparable changed prefix or same-size suffix means replacement.
comments.zh: /// 长度小于游标表示截断；可比首指纹变化或同长尾指纹变化表示替换。

comments.en: /// When growing small files change sample length, rely on creation time and monotonic length instead.
comments.zh: /// 小文件增长导致采样长度变化时，改按创建时间和长度单调性判断。

comments.en: /// JSONL cursor persisted in ingestion_checkpoints.cursor_value.
comments.zh: /// JSONL 游标（持久化在 ingestion_checkpoints.cursor_value）。

comments.en: // A growing small file changes prefix length; unchanged creation time and increasing length permit append.
comments.zh: // 小文件增长：首采样长度变化，指纹不可比，但创建时间一致且长度递增 → 追加。

comments.zh: /// 分块搜索至 4 MiB；仍无用量时返回 Pending，下轮重探。

comments.zh: // 枚举后暂时持锁、超时或被删除：Pending，下轮重探，不永久记录失败。

comments.en: // Usage after the initial window but within the search limit.
comments.zh: // 用量出现在头部窗口之后，但仍在搜索上限内。

comments.zh: // 类型化日志在搜索窗口内没有用量，可能是会话早期，尚无法判断。

comments.zh: // Pending 下轮重新探测，与未知格式区别处理；拒绝规则见 framework.rs。

comments.en: //! Incremental SQLite rules: see the per-input strategies in architecture.md.
comments.zh: //! 增量约定（architecture.md「各输入的增量策略」SQLite 行）：

comments.en: //! - Persist a schema fingerprint (tables/key columns) in the parse context; a changed fingerprint
comments.zh: //! - schema 指纹（表/关键列存在性）持久化于解析上下文；指纹变化 ⇒ 已处理位置重置

comments.en: //!   resets the processing position for a full reread with idempotent upserts by ID.
comments.zh: //!   全量重读（id 键 upsert 幂等，不双计）；

comments.en: //! - Stable key: message.id; revision: message.time_updated (event source_revision).
comments.zh: //! - 稳定键 = message.id，更新序号 = message.time_updated（事件 source_revision）；

comments.en: //! - A 60-second overlap before the processed timestamp covers out-of-order same-millisecond
comments.zh: //! - 已处理时间 + 60s 有界重叠窗（覆盖并发会话同毫秒写入，重复行按

comments.en: //!   writes from concurrent sessions; identical key/content pairs remain idempotent.
comments.zh: //!   同键同内容幂等）；

comments.en: //! - message has both time_created/time_updated; it does not need a created_at-only bounded reread.
comments.zh: //! - message 表同时有 time_created/time_updated，无需 created_at-only 有界重扫；

comments.en: //! - Limit each round to 50,000 rows. BudgetExhausted retains the last complete millisecond.
comments.zh: //! - 每轮行数上限 50,000：触顶 ⇒ BudgetExhausted，已处理位置停在最后一个完整毫秒；

comments.en: //! - Cursor offset stays zero: an unchanged main-file size under WAL does not mean unchanged content.
comments.zh: //! - 游标 `offset` 恒为 0：WAL 下主库文件长度不变不代表内容未变，

comments.en: //!   Do not use byte length to skip reads; framework checks and generation handling still apply.
comments.zh: //!   字节长度不能用于跳过读取；框架检查与 generation 处理仍生效。

comments.en: //!   In-place page rewrites change the header change counter and trigger framework Rescan;
comments.zh: //!   in-place 页重写会改变文件头（change counter）触发框架 Rescan 标记，

comments.en: //!   this parser preserves the processing position because IDs/revisions remain valid in the same logical database.
comments.zh: //!   本实现不因 rescan 重置已处理位置（同一逻辑库的 id/更新序号仍有效）。

comments.en: /// Timestamp overlap in milliseconds covers out-of-order same-millisecond child-session writes.
comments.zh: /// 已处理时间的回看窗（毫秒）：覆盖并发子会话的同毫秒乱序写。

comments.en: /// Per-round row limit; resume the incomplete millisecond on the next round.
comments.zh: /// 单轮行数上限：触顶停在该毫秒边界，下轮续读。

comments.en: /// Cursor persisted in ingestion_checkpoints.cursor_value.
comments.zh: /// 游标（持久化在 ingestion_checkpoints.cursor_value）。

comments.en: /// Always zero; database change detection cannot use byte offsets under WAL.
comments.zh: /// 恒为 0：DB 不用字节偏移做无变化判定（WAL 见模块头）。

comments.en: /// Last processed message.time_updated, inclusive; None starts a complete scan.
comments.zh: /// 已处理到的 message.time_updated（含该值）；None = 从头全量。

comments.en: /// Parse context stores the schema fingerprint and version selection alongside the cursor.
comments.zh: /// 解析上下文：schema 指纹 + 版本分派结论（游标期间库结构/版本的持久快照）。

comments.en: /// Record failures persist across incremental windows until the row is successfully reread.
comments.zh: /// 单行读取失败保留至后续增量扫描，直到成功重读该行。

comments.en: // Store only message.id as the diagnostic position, excluding paths and message bodies.
comments.zh: // 位置只存 message.id（稳定身份，非路径/正文）。

comments.en: /// Highest numeric session.version; the same database may contain sessions from several versions.
comments.zh: /// 库内数值最大 session.version（一个库可混存多版本会话）。

comments.en: /// Parse the five exclusive components in message.data.tokens.
comments.zh: /// 解析 message.data.tokens（五互斥字段）。

comments.en: /// Require input/output/cache.read/cache.write, present in all 13,342 native assistant rows;
comments.zh: /// input/output/cache.read/cache.write 四者必需（本机实读 13,342/13,342 成立）；

comments.en: /// optional reasoning/total remain unknown when absent. Invalid types or ranges return None.
comments.zh: /// reasoning/total 可缺失（缺失是未知，不是 0）。越界/类型错误返回 None。

comments.en: // Prefer completion time (source_completion), then start time (source_start),
comments.zh: // 时间：优先完成时间（source_completion），未完成退开始时间（source_start），

comments.en: // then row time_created with uncertain time basis.
comments.zh: // 再退行级 time_created（uncertain）。

comments.en: // Missing finish and error leaves a partial event. Completion raises time_updated;
comments.zh: // 无 finish 与 error 时记 partial；完成后 time_updated 提升，

comments.en: // the same key can then replace it with a final event using source_revision.
comments.zh: // 同键按 source_revision 替换为 final。

comments.en: /// Reconcile one session's five per-message assistant components against five cumulative session columns.
comments.zh: /// 单会话对账：逐次五字段合计（assistant）vs session 行五列合计。

comments.en: /// Incrementally scan kilo.db, called by KiloAdapter::scan.
comments.zh: /// 增量扫描一个 kilo.db（统一入口 `KiloAdapter::scan` 分派到本实现）。

comments.en: // Do not filter the cursor by generation: in-place rewrites of the same logical database trigger Rescan,
comments.zh: // 游标不做 generation 过滤：同一逻辑库的 in-place 重写会让框架标 Rescan，

comments.en: // but IDs/revisions retain a valid processing position. A changed logical identity has empty stored state and scans fully.
comments.zh: // 但 id/更新序号记录的已处理位置仍有效；换了逻辑库（身份变化）时 stored 为空自然全量。

comments.en: // A changed schema fingerprint resets the old position for a full, idempotent reread by ID.
comments.zh: // schema 指纹变化 ⇒ 旧的已处理位置不可信，全量重读（id 幂等，不双计）。

comments.en: // A mutable source can remove invalid rows; deleted rows do not degrade its current health.
comments.zh: // 来源可修改或删除曾经无效的行；已删除的行不影响当前来源状态。

comments.en: // Only assistant messages contribute model_call usage (A11).
comments.zh: // role 过滤：只 assistant 的 usage 记 model_call（A11）。

comments.en: // Mixed-version databases require each session's version; the highest version does not verify other sessions.
comments.zh: // 一个库可含多个版本；最高版本不能验证其他会话消息的格式。

comments.en: // An assistant without usage still identifies a call:
comments.zh: // 无 usage 的 assistant 消息仍表明发生过一次调用：

comments.en: // Flat fields take precedence.

comments.zh: // 重复扫描幂等：内容相同则不变更。

comments.zh: /// 已证明互斥覆盖的汇总 token 求和（Hermes 样本 11：100+20=120 而非 220）。

comments.en: /// Exclude duplicates; exclude and separately count overlap_unknown rows.
comments.zh: /// duplicate 行不参与；overlap_unknown 行不参与并单独计数。

comments.en: /// Cumulative series state, persisted in ingestion_checkpoints.parse_context.
comments.zh: /// 累计序列状态（持久化在 ingestion_checkpoints.parse_context）。

comments.en: /// Process/series start, when known.
comments.zh: /// 进程/series 起点（已知时）。

comments.en: /// Result of observing a cumulative value.
comments.zh: /// 累计观察结果。

comments.en: /// Late or conflicting same-time observations keep the baseline; the caller records diagnostics.
comments.zh: /// 迟到或同一采样时点内容不一致；保留现有基线，交给调用方诊断。

comments.en: /// First cumulative observation: preserve the native interval total without assigning it to today.
comments.zh: /// 首次看到累计值：保存为源原生区间总量，不硬塞进今天。

comments.en: /// Interval difference, including zero.
comments.zh: /// 区间增量（含 0）。

comments.en: /// Confirmed reset, such as a new process; its baseline is the new interval total.
comments.zh: /// 已确认发生重置（新进程）：新基线即新区间量。

comments.en: /// Unconfirmed decrease: record a conflict rather than treating the new value as a zero-based total.
comments.zh: /// 累计值下降但无法确认发生重置：不按零重新累加，记冲突诊断。

comments.en: /// Repeated equal values yield Delta zero; callers deduplicate the resulting observations.
comments.zh: /// 相同值再次观察得到 Delta 0；由调用方确保同一观察不重复计入。

comments.en: /// Quota snapshot input; keep quotas separate from recorded usage without converting units.
comments.zh: /// 额度快照输入；额度与已记录用量分开，不转换单位。

comments.zh: /// 额度类型包括 credits、subscription_window、balance 和 rate_limit。

comments.en: /// Integer smallest unit; unknown is None rather than zero.
comments.zh: /// 整数最小单位；未知为 None，不补零。

comments.en: /// True only for verified usage on this device; an account-wide quota does not establish local usage.
comments.zh: /// 仅已确认属于本机用量时为 true；账号级额度不能确认本机用量。

comments.en: //! Opt-in local reminders. Unknown observations never become zero.
comments.zh: //! 本机提醒由用户启用；未知用量保持未知，不补零。

comments.en: /// Integer tokens or micro currency units, serialized exactly for IPC.
comments.zh: /// 整数 token 或百万分之一货币单位；IPC 序列化保留精确值。

comments.en: /// Claim only after a visible GUI requests the reminder; headless scans do not consume it.
comments.zh: /// 仅在可见 GUI 请求提醒后标记已领取；后台扫描不消耗提醒。

comments.en: // Keep the complete identity: a hash collision must not suppress a reminder.
comments.zh: // 保留完整身份；哈希碰撞不能使提醒被跳过。

comments.zh: /// 一周起始日。默认周一（ISO）；周日起始时周标签必须使用开始日期。

comments.en: /// A fixed IANA timezone keeps this Calendar independent of later system timezone changes.
comments.zh: /// 固定 IANA 时区，使此 Calendar 不受后续系统时区变化影响。

comments.en: /// UTC milliseconds to local date.
comments.zh: /// UTC 毫秒 → 本地日。

comments.zh: /// UTC 毫秒 → 本地小时（0–23）。DST 重复小时的两次出现得到同一标签，

comments.en: /// Use [`Calendar::offset_seconds_at`] to distinguish their offsets.
comments.zh: /// 需要区分时用 [`Calendar::offset_seconds_at`]。

comments.en: /// UTC milliseconds to ISO weekday, Monday=1 through Sunday=7.
comments.zh: /// UTC 毫秒 → ISO 星期几（周一=1 … 周日=7）。

comments.en: /// UTC offset seconds at this instant, distinguishing repeated DST hours.
comments.zh: /// UTC 毫秒 → 该时刻的 UTC offset 秒（分辨 DST 重复小时）。

comments.en: /// Local date as UTC [start_ms, end_ms); DST days may contain 23 or 25 hours.
comments.zh: /// 本地日的 UTC 半开区间 `[start_ms, end_ms)`。DST 日长度可为 23/25 小时；

comments.en: /// jiff resolves a nonexistent local midnight to the next valid time.
comments.zh: /// 不存在的本地午夜由 jiff 顺延到首个有效时刻。

comments.en: /// Local date containing now_ms.
comments.zh: /// now 所在本地日。

comments.en: /// Retain today and the preceding D-1 local dates; cutoff is today minus D-1 days.
comments.zh: /// 有限保留 D 天的截止本地日：今天起点往前 D−1 天；今天与前 D−1 个本地日保留。

comments.en: /// First date of this local week, using week_start.
comments.zh: /// 本地日所在周的起始日（按 week_start）。

comments.en: /// Monday-start labels use ISO week/year, such as 2026-W01;
comments.zh: /// 周标签：周一起始用 ISO 周（标签含周所属年份，如 2026-W01）；

comments.en: /// Sunday-start labels use their start date, such as 2025-12-28.
comments.zh: /// 周日起始用开始日期（如 2025-12-28），不能冒充 ISO 周。

comments.en: /// First local date of the calendar month.
comments.zh: /// 本地日所在自然月的第一天。

comments.en: /// Month label, such as 2026-09.
/// Calendar month as a half-open UTC interval.
comments.zh: /// 月份 UTC 半开区间。

comments.en: /// ISO 8601 (week-year, week-number): the week's Thursday determines its year.
comments.zh: /// ISO 8601 周：(周所属年份, 周号)。算法：本周周四所属年即 ISO 年；

comments.en: /// Week number = (Thursday day-of-year - 1) / 7 + 1.
comments.zh: /// 周号 = (周四的年内序数 - 1) / 7 + 1。

comments.en: /// Parse YYYY-MM-DD.
comments.zh: /// 解析 YYYY-MM-DD。

comments.en: /// Last date of the month for displayed end labels.
comments.zh: /// 月份最后一天（用于月区间结束标签显示）。

comments.en: /// Date constructor for tests and callers.
comments.zh: /// 便捷构造（测试与调用方）。

comments.zh: // 普通日 24 小时。

comments.zh: /// 额度标识：premium_interactions / chat / completions。

comments.zh: // 删除去除前导空白后以 // 开头的注释行，保留 JSON 正文。

comments.zh: // Linux / 其他：XDG_CACHE_HOME 优先，否则 ~/.cache。

comments.zh: // 事件、累计值与归档分区共用一个只读快照。

comments.zh: // 留存的归档来源日汇总不能用不完整明细导出重建。

comments.en: //! Domain types: normalized records, tokens, lifecycle, model identity, time and source ownership.
comments.zh: //! 领域类型：标准化记录、token 字段、生命周期、模型身份、时间与来源归属。

comments.en: //! Field meanings follow docs/design/desktop-usage/data-contract.md.
comments.zh: //! 字段含义遵循 docs/design/desktop-usage/data-contract.md。

comments.en: /// Maximum value for one token field (2^62). Reject larger values with an error;
comments.zh: /// 单个 token 字段允许的最大值（2^62）。超过即拒绝该记录并报错，

comments.en: /// preserve integer precision and check aggregate additions for overflow.
comments.zh: /// 禁止转为浮点近似；聚合时再以防溢出加法保护。

comments.en: /// Reject timestamps before 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z to catch mistaken seconds/milliseconds.
comments.zh: /// 早于该毫秒的时间戳视为不可信（2000-01-01T00:00:00Z），用于发现秒/毫秒误判。

comments.en: /// Field quality: reported means the source reports a value, without establishing the final bill.
comments.zh: /// 单个字段的数据质量。`reported` 只代表来源报告，不承诺等于最终账单。

comments.en: /// Record kinds; statistical behavior follows the data rules for requests, messages and cumulative values.
comments.zh: /// 记录类型。统计行为见数据规范「请求、消息与累计值」。

comments.en: /// One observed model call/attempt; the basic request-count unit.
comments.zh: /// 已观测到的一次模型调用/尝试；request 指标的基本单位。

comments.en: /// HTTP/WebSocket reconnect or retry; count separately without increasing model_call directly.
comments.zh: /// HTTP/WebSocket 重连或重试；独立计数，不直接增加 model_call。

comments.en: /// A usage observation; its relationship to calls may be one-to-many or many-to-one.
comments.zh: /// 一条 usage 记录；与调用可能一对多或多对一。

comments.en: /// Session/process cumulative snapshot; take differences by identity/reset boundaries rather than sum rows.
comments.zh: /// 会话/进程累计快照；按身份与重置边界求差，不能逐条求和。

comments.en: /// Native day/session or other aggregate, retaining its original scope.
comments.zh: /// 官方按日/会话等给出的汇总；保留原生范围。

comments.en: /// Quota, credits, subscription window or balance, displayed separately.
comments.zh: /// 额度、积分、订阅窗口、余额；独立显示。

comments.en: /// Streaming partial values, final values or corrections.
comments.zh: /// 生命周期：流式部分值 / 最终值 / 更正。

comments.en: /// Primary, subagent, auxiliary or unknown call category.
comments.zh: /// 调用类别：主调用 / 子 Agent / 辅助 / 未知。

comments.en: /// Model attribution; keep unknown without structured information available by the call time.
comments.zh: /// 模型归属依据。没有不晚于调用的结构化记录时保持 unknown。

comments.en: /// Model field on the request itself.
comments.zh: /// 请求自身字段。

comments.en: /// Structured model change/turn context available by the call time.
comments.zh: /// 不晚于调用的结构化模型变更/turn context。

comments.en: /// Source mapping, such as turn_context ownership.
comments.zh: /// 来源映射（如 turn_context 归属）。

comments.en: /// Time basis: assign midnight-crossing calls by native completion; identify start-only timestamps.
comments.zh: /// 时间依据。跨午夜请求默认归到来源记录的完成时间；只有开始时间时明确标记。

comments.en: /// Native timezone/time configuration has not been verified.
comments.zh: /// 没有可证实的源时区/时间配置。

comments.en: /// Version selection follows architecture.md compatibility rules:
comments.zh: /// 版本选择依据（architecture.md 未知版本兼容约定）：

comments.en: /// dispatch known versions through the registry; unknown/missing versions try the latest built-in reader
comments.zh: /// 已知版本按注册表映射分派；未知/缺失版本先尝试该 Agent 最新内置解析器，

comments.en: /// for that Agent. Record compatibility separately from token-field quality.
comments.zh: /// 结果带兼容标记，兼容状态与 token 字段质量分别记录。

comments.en: /// Basis for identifying this device as the source.
comments.zh: /// 本机归属依据。

comments.en: /// Ownership verification; records with unverified ownership do not enter totals.
comments.zh: /// 归属核验状态。无法确认归属的记录不进入总计。

comments.en: /// Token fields; missing values are None (stored as NULL), without replacement zeros.
comments.zh: /// token 字段集合。缺失为 None（落盘为 NULL），绝不补零。

comments.en: /// Original source total, compared with normalized totals; disagreements produce diagnostics.
comments.zh: /// 来源原始总量，与规范化总量比较；不一致记诊断。

comments.en: /// Validate every field as nonnegative and within the limit; reject an out-of-range record.
comments.zh: /// 逐字段校验：非负、不超过上限。超限拒绝整条记录。

comments.en: /// Per-field quality matching TokenUsage; unknown fields must have no value.
comments.zh: /// 逐字段质量，与 [`TokenUsage`] 同形。unknown 字段不允许有值。

comments.en: /// Event quality category, used when grouping daily aggregates.
comments.zh: /// 事件质量类别，用于按质量分组的日汇总。

comments.en: /// Both input and output totals are known.
comments.zh: /// 输入与输出总量均已知。

comments.en: /// Some token fields are known.
comments.zh: /// 部分字段已知。

comments.en: /// At least one field is estimated.
comments.zh: /// 任一字段为估算。

comments.en: /// No token field is known.
comments.zh: /// 没有任何已知 token 字段。

comments.en: /// Cost in integer smallest units with a currency; avoid floating-point accumulation.
comments.zh: /// 费用：整数最小单位 + 币种，不用二进制浮点累加。

comments.en: /// Normalized ingest event: model_call, transport_attempt or usage_observation.

comments.zh: /// 来源稳定记录键（response/request ID、会话 UUID+序号、文件身份+位置等）。

comments.zh: /// 入库前校验：token 字段非负有上限；时间戳 plausible（毫秒而非秒）。

comments.en: /// Core failures remain explicit and diagnosable without silent degradation.
comments.zh: /// 核心错误类型。所有失败必须显式可诊断，不做静默降级。

comments.en: /// SQLite error.
comments.zh: /// SQLite 层错误。

comments.en: /// I/O error, including size checks and temporary directories.
comments.zh: /// IO 错误（容量统计、临时目录等）。

comments.zh: /// 数据库格式不可用或新于支持版本，拒绝可写初始化，不破坏性降级。

comments.en: /// Schema mismatch under rebuild rules; the application requests confirmation to rebuild or exit.
comments.zh: /// schema 版本不匹配，应用按重建规则请求用户确认重建或退出。

comments.zh: /// 迁移执行失败；旧库保持不变。

comments.en: /// Invalid record, such as negative/oversized values or implausible timestamps.
comments.zh: /// 记录校验失败（负值、超过上限、时间明显不合理等）。

comments.zh: /// token 聚合溢出（i64 上溢防护）。

comments.zh: /// 时区/日历计算失败。

comments.zh: /// 调度/作业状态机非法转移。

comments.en: /// Invalid query parameters, such as period grouping incompatible with the range.
comments.zh: /// 查询参数无效，例如时间分组与范围不匹配。

comments.en: /// Test hook injected a failure.
comments.zh: /// 注入了故障（测试钩子）。

comments.en: /// Cooperative collection stop; not a parser or source-health failure.
comments.zh: /// 协作式停止采集，不视为解析或来源健康失败。

comments.en: /// JSON serialization failure.
comments.zh: /// JSON 序列化失败。

comments.zh: /// 列名只来自上方有类型的序列化实现，不来自输入 JSON。

comments.zh: // 重导自己的快照不能归档仍活动的来源日，进而

comments.zh: // 阻止后续请求计入该汇总。

comments.zh: //! 历史来源交换约定（M1a，data-contract.md#provenance）：

comments.zh: //! 版本化导出，以及重复、新修订、独立来源贡献和冲突的合并规则。

comments.en: //! Boundaries:
//! - this module defines formats, builds exports and resolves records; aggregate writes live in exchange_import;
comments.zh: //! 本模块定义格式、构建导出并比较记录；汇总写入由 exchange_import 实现。

comments.en: //! - display CSV/charts are not lossless reimport packages;
comments.zh: //! - 展示用 CSV/图表不满足本约定，不得被当作无损回导文件。

comments.en: //! - batch_id prevents duplicate import operations without replacing source-record identity;
comments.zh: //! - 批次身份（batch_id）只保证导入操作幂等，不替代来源记录身份。

comments.en: //! - exports may redact hostname labels while retaining stable source keys.
comments.zh: //! - 导出允许主机名别名化或省略（redact_hostnames），稳定来源键不重写。

comments.en: /// Full or incremental export; omission from an incremental package is not deletion.
comments.zh: /// 导出类型：完整快照或增量。同一范围未出现于增量包不表示删除；

comments.en: /// Explicit deletions declare removed source-record keys.
comments.zh: /// 删除或整段替换语义由导出方在 `deletions` 中显式声明。

comments.en: /// Lower-bound event timestamp in milliseconds; None imposes no incremental lower bound.
comments.zh: /// 增量事件时间下界，单位毫秒；None 表示不限制增量下界。

comments.en: /// Deleted keys as (source_instance_id, source_record_key).
comments.zh: /// 显式删除/整段替换声明：被删除事件的 (source_instance_id, source_record_key)。

comments.en: /// Empty declarations mean no deletion.
comments.zh: /// 空表示无删除语义。

comments.en: /// Deletion reason, such as observed source cleanup, without message content.
comments.zh: /// 删除依据（如源端清理观察）；不含正文。

comments.en: /// Source host registration: hostname labels may be redacted, while host_id stays unchanged.
comments.zh: /// 来源主机注册信息。主机名可脱敏（别名化/省略），host_id 不重写。

comments.en: /// Original source-instance registration; an importing machine must not replace its ownership.
comments.zh: /// 来源实例注册信息（原始来源，导入机不得改成自己）。

comments.en: /// Selected field coverage/capability JSON without message content.
comments.zh: /// 选定字段的覆盖与能力 JSON，不含消息正文。

comments.en: /// Source plus record key identifies an exchange event; values and coverage travel with it.
comments.zh: /// 逐事件交换记录：来源 + 记录键构成逻辑唯一键；数值与完整性随记录走。

comments.en: /// Eight nullable token fields; preserve unknowns without filling zeros.
comments.zh: /// 八个 token 字段可空（unknown 不补零）。

comments.en: /// Event quality category: complete, partial, estimated or unknown, distinct from per-field quality.
comments.zh: /// 事件质量类别为 complete、partial、estimated 或 unknown，与逐字段质量分开。

comments.en: /// Values correspond to usage_events columns; null means unknown.
comments.zh: /// 与 usage_events 数值列一一对应；null = unknown。

comments.en: /// Daily/sealed partitions preserve source/revision when details are deleted.
comments.zh: /// 日/封存分区（明细已清理时历史汇总仍可导出，保留来源与修订）。

comments.en: /// Retained hourly rows merge by timezone/day/hour/dimensions.
comments.zh: /// 小时层交换行（按配置保留；导入按 (tz,day,hour,dims) 键合并）。

comments.en: /// Complete export package.
comments.zh: /// 完整导出包。

comments.en: /// Batch identity prevents repeated imports without replacing record identity.
comments.zh: /// 批次身份：同一批次重复导入幂等；不替代记录身份。

comments.en: /// All daily partitions, including recent days with retained details; aggregate imports use them
comments.zh: /// 全部日分区，包含仍有明细的近期日期。聚合导入仅使用这些分区，

comments.en: /// without adding records again, and desktop aggregate exports omit records.
comments.zh: /// 不把 records 再次相加；桌面聚合导出省略 records。

comments.en: /// Hourly history remains available after detail deletion.
comments.zh: /// 小时层（今日小时图在明细删除后的数据来源）。

comments.en: /// Export request.
comments.zh: /// 导出请求。

comments.en: /// Event range [from_ms, to_ms) in milliseconds.
comments.zh: /// 事件时间范围为 [from_ms, to_ms)，单位毫秒。

comments.en: /// None selects all sources; Some([]) selects none.
comments.zh: /// None 选择全部来源；Some([]) 不选择任何来源。

comments.en: /// True omits hostname labels from exports.
comments.zh: /// true 时省略主机名（导出脱敏）。

comments.en: /// Build an export through read-only queries.
comments.zh: /// 构建导出包（只读查询）。

comments.en: /// Aggregate-only desktop exchange omits raw request/session identities.
comments.zh: /// 桌面仅汇总交换包不包含原始请求和会话标识。

comments.en: // The package uses the local host; each source retains its original host ownership on reexport.
comments.zh: // 包主机取本机身份；每个来源另存原始主机，避免再导出改写历史归属。

comments.en: // Register included source instances and their original origin_host_id metadata.
comments.zh: // 来源注册：本导出涉及的实例（含其 origin_host_id 关联的原始注册信息）。

comments.en: // Event details.
comments.zh: // 事件明细。

comments.en: // All daily partitions, including recent unsealed days, retain source/revision/coverage counts.
comments.zh: // 全部日分区（含近期未封存日期），保留来源、修订和完整性计数。

comments.en: // Export only retained hourly rows; import merges by revision.
comments.zh: // 小时层（有界：仅现存的；导入按修订合并）。

comments.en: /// Existing record metadata for an import merge decision.
comments.zh: /// 合并判定输入：现存记录元数据（导入侧从库中读出）。

comments.en: /// Merge result, following the data rules.
comments.zh: /// 合并判定结论（data-contract.md 合并规则表）。

comments.en: /// Add a new record with independent coverage;
comments.zh: /// 新来源/新记录键（覆盖互斥）：新增独立贡献；

comments.en: /// still deduplicate mirrored events rather than summing solely because source IDs differ.
comments.zh: /// 跨源镜像仍按事件冲突选择规则去重；来源 ID 不同不代表可以直接相加。

comments.en: /// Same source/key/revision/content is a duplicate; repeated exchange does not add usage.
comments.zh: /// 同一来源记录键、同修订且内容一致：幂等跳过，重复导出/导入不增量。

comments.en: /// Replace after revoking the old contribution when revision/lifecycle establishes a newer correction;
comments.zh: /// 修订号或生命周期确认较新的更正时，撤销旧贡献再替换；

comments.en: /// otherwise record Conflict without choosing by token magnitude.
comments.zh: /// 无法确认修订顺序时不按 token 大小裁决，落 Conflict。

comments.en: /// Conflicting content with unresolved ordering retains the existing record and marks conflict.
comments.zh: /// 内容冲突且无法确定先后顺序时，保留现存记录并标记冲突。

comments.en: /// Reuse ingest resolution: revision first, then lifecycle;
comments.zh: /// 逐记录合并复用 ingest 的选择顺序：修订号优先，其次生命周期；

comments.en: /// conflicting content at the same level remains a conflict.
comments.zh: /// 同层级内容不同 → 冲突），保证交换判定与本地写入语义一致。

comments.en: /// Build an EventInput for resolution of identity/revision/lifecycle/content hash.
comments.zh: /// 构造合并比较事件：仅比较身份、修订、生命周期与内容哈希，

comments.en: /// This comparison does not read usage, so the temporary event has empty token fields.
comments.zh: /// arbitrate 需要 EventInput；用量不参与该合并比较，保持为空。

comments.en: //! Identity and deduplication: event_id namespaces source instance/record key; content hashes
comments.zh: //! 身份与去重：event_id 命名空间（源实例+源记录键）、内容哈希（仅变更检测）、

comments.en: //! detect changes; revision/lifecycle comparisons select streamed, final or corrected records.
comments.zh: //! 按修订号及生命周期比较同请求的流式、完成和更正记录。

comments.en: //! Compare both source revisions when present; otherwise partial < final < corrected.
comments.zh: //! 双方都有源修订号时按其排序；否则比较生命周期 partial < final < corrected。

comments.en: //! Unordered differing content retains the existing record with conflict diagnostics, never MAX.
comments.zh: //! 无法确定新旧且内容不同时保留现存记录，标 conflict 并记录诊断，不取 MAX。

comments.en: /// event_id joins source instance and record key. The composite unique constraint
comments.zh: /// event_id = 源实例命名空间 + 源记录键。复合唯一约束 (source_instance_id,

comments.en: /// (source_instance_id, source_record_key) identifies the record; this string supports logs/references.
comments.zh: /// source_record_key) 标识记录；此字符串用于日志及跨表引用。

comments.en: /// Observation time changes on rescanning without changing source content.
comments.zh: /// 采集观察时间会随重扫改变，不代表源记录发生变化。

comments.en: /// parse_basis records known_version/latest_fallback. Registry verification upgrades
comments.zh: /// parse_basis 是解析依据（known_version/latest_fallback），同一记录随注册表

comments.en: /// do not change source content, so this field is also excluded from the content hash.
comments.zh: /// 扩展升级为已验证不构成内容变更，同样不参与内容哈希。

comments.en: /// FNV-1a 64-bit content hash detects changes; it cannot identify an event independently.
comments.zh: /// FNV-1a 64 位内容哈希：只用于变更检测，不独立作为事件身份。

comments.en: /// Existing metadata used to compare incoming records.
comments.zh: /// 比较新旧记录所用的现存元数据。

comments.en: /// Outcome of comparing a record with existing content.
comments.zh: /// 新记录与现存内容的比较结果。

comments.en: /// No existing record: insert.
comments.zh: /// 无现存记录：插入。

comments.en: /// A higher revision/lifecycle replaces the old contribution with the new values.
comments.zh: /// 修订号或生命周期更高时替换，并撤销旧统计量、应用新值。

comments.en: /// Keep the higher existing revision/lifecycle or identical content without duplicate usage.
comments.zh: /// 现存修订号或生命周期更高，或内容相同，则保留而不重复计数。

comments.en: /// Unordered different content: retain the existing record, mark conflict and diagnose.
comments.zh: /// 内容不同且无法判断新旧时保留现存值，标 conflict 并记录诊断。

comments.en: /// Compare source revisions before lifecycle; equal precedence with different content is conflict.
comments.zh: /// 优先比较源修订号，再比较生命周期；优先级相同且内容不同则为冲突。

comments.en: // Missing revision on either side uses lifecycle; equal lifecycle/content keeps, differing content conflicts.
comments.zh: // 一方缺修订号时按生命周期比较；同级同内容保留，同级不同内容冲突。

comments.en: // A higher source revision replaces even with a lower lifecycle.
comments.zh: // 修订号更高：即使生命周期更低也替换（源明确排序）。

comments.en: // A lower source revision retains the existing record.
comments.zh: // 修订号更低：保留。

comments.en: // Equal revision and content adds no usage.
comments.zh: // 相同修订号及内容不增加用量。

comments.en: // Equal revision with different content is conflict.
comments.zh: // 同修订号不同内容：conflict。

comments.en: //! Commit event updates, cursors, parse context and affected daily aggregates in one ingest transaction.
comments.zh: //! ingest 批次：事件 upsert + 游标 + 解析上下文 + 受影响日汇总在同一事务提交。

comments.en: //! Replay uncommitted interrupted batches without duplicates: update events by key and recompute daily partitions.
comments.zh: //! 中断前未提交的批次可重放；重放幂等（事件按键 upsert、日汇总按日分区重算）。

comments.en: /// Existing usage_events metadata used to resolve duplicates.
comments.zh: /// usage_events 中已存在记录的去重判定视图。

comments.en: /// Cursor and versioned parse-context updates: model state, cumulative baseline and unfinished requests.
comments.zh: /// 游标与版本化解析上下文更新（模型状态、累计基线、未完成请求）。

comments.en: /// Redacted batch diagnostics: field names, error codes and positions, without original row content.
comments.zh: /// 批次内诊断（脱敏：字段名/错误码/位置，不复制原始行内容）。

comments.en: /// One ingest batch; every event belongs to the same source instance.
comments.zh: /// 单个 ingest 批次，其事件均属于同一来源实例。

comments.en: /// Source instance for this batch.
comments.zh: /// 本批次来源实例。

comments.en: /// Fixed IANA timezone for grouping; stored settings do not follow later system changes.
comments.zh: /// 分桶用固定 IANA 时区（保存后不随系统变化）。

comments.en: /// Associated running job; commit its batch statistics in the same transaction.
comments.zh: /// 关联的运行中作业：批次统计与其同事务提交。

comments.en: /// UTC-millisecond retention cutoff: skip older events with diagnostics instead of restoring deleted details.
comments.zh: /// 保留截止（UTC 毫秒）：更早的事件被跳过并记诊断，不允许复活已清理明细。

comments.en: /// V09 fault-injection points; failure must roll back the whole transaction and permit identical replay.
comments.zh: /// 故障注入点（V09）。在任何定义点失败都必须整体回滚，重放结果相同。

comments.en: /// Local days affected by recomputation, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
comments.zh: /// 本次重算影响的本地日（YYYY-MM-DD）。

comments.en: /// Commit in one transaction; the fault test hook forces complete rollback.
comments.zh: /// 提交批次：单一事务。fault 为测试钩子，注入后整体回滚。

comments.en: // Test-frozen schemas before v3 lack parse_basis; write using the historical schema
comments.zh: // schema < 3（测试钩子冻结的旧库）没有 parse_basis 列：按旧 schema 降级写入，

comments.en: // without that field. Normal startup migrates to SCHEMA_VERSION first.
comments.zh: // 新字段不持久化（等价历史行为）。正常运行总是先迁移到 SCHEMA_VERSION。

comments.en: // 1. Insert or update events.
comments.zh: // 1. 事件 upsert。

comments.en: // The v1 content hash included observed_at; an observation-time change alone is duplicate content.
comments.zh: // v1 的内容摘要包含 observed_at；仅观察时间改变仍视为同一内容。

comments.en: // Same-key final repeats differing only in occurrence/observation/native time are repeated reports, not conflicts.
comments.zh: // 同键同内容的重复 final（仅发生/观察/源时间文本不同）是重报而非冲突，同样视为同一内容。

comments.en: // Full prior hashes permit only parser-metadata changes; retain original time, usage and source revision.
comments.zh: // 完整旧摘要只允许解析器依据变化；保留原时间、用量和源修订。

comments.en: // Later metadata updates cannot clear a real conflict already observed in this batch.
comments.zh: // 同批次已观测的实际冲突不能被后续的元数据更新清除。

comments.en: // Explicit source-correction policies compare the complete old hash.
comments.zh: // 明确的来源修正规则比较完整旧摘要，

comments.en: // Retain first observation, real conflict flags and all change history
comments.zh: // 修正已核对字段时保留首次观察、真实冲突标记

comments.en: // while correcting only verified fields.
comments.zh: // 和全部变更历史。

comments.en: // Keep the existing conflicting value rather than choose a larger one; diagnose and recompute its daily conflict count.
comments.zh: // 不任意择大：保留现存，标 conflict 并记诊断；所在日重算以反映冲突计数。

comments.en: // Record mathematical contradictions as diagnostics instead of hiding them with max(0, ...).
comments.zh: // 数学矛盾进入受限诊断（不用 max(0,…) 隐藏）。

comments.en: // 2. Commit cursors and parse context together; separate stages make fault-injection points explicit.
comments.zh: // 2. 游标与解析上下文（同事务；分两段以便故障点语义清晰）。

comments.en: // 3. Advance the data revision when days are affected; recomputed daily rows carry that revision.
comments.zh: // 3. 有受影响日期时递增数据修订号；重算的日汇总携带该修订号。

comments.en: // 4. Recompute affected timezone/day partitions without adding to sealed days; persist hours
comments.zh: // 4. 受影响日按（时区, 日）分区重算；封存日不追加。小时分桶同事务持久化

comments.en: // in the same transaction so hourly archives survive later deletion of details.
comments.zh: //    （分级归档：明细删除后小时层仍有数据）。

comments.en: // 5. Store redacted diagnostics.
// 6. Commit job progress in the same transaction.
comments.zh: // 6. 作业进度同事务提交。

comments.en: /// Compare complete prior events; a renamed parser is not a source revision or permission to change other fields.
comments.zh: /// 比较完整旧事件摘要，不把解析器更名当作源修订或允许其他字段变化。

comments.en: // Match normal same-key final-repeat time handling; metadata updates still retain original timestamps.
comments.zh: // 同键重复 final 的时间兼容与普通冲突处理一致；元数据更新仍保留原时间。

comments.en: /// Reconstruct the complete doc1 event for the verified native writer only.
comments.zh: /// 仅为已核对的原生写入器重建完整 doc1 事件。

comments.en: /// All positive counters, identity and attribution must still match the old hash.

comments.en: //! input_total sums three exclusive input buckets; total_tokens = input_total + output_total.

comments.en: /// Sum known values without overflow; any unknown component makes the complete sum unknown.
comments.zh: /// 已知字段求和，任一未知则整体未知。防溢出。

comments.en: /// The second result component describes field quality.

comments.zh: /// 进入诊断，不用 max(0, …) 隐藏。

comments.en: /// Exact integer numerator/denominator; None for a zero denominator or no valid samples (display —).
comments.zh: /// 比例：分子/分母的精确整数对。分母为零或无有效样本时返回 None（显示"—"）。

comments.zh: /// coding-plan 占位、聚合商（非官方）、零价模型、长上下文档、0 分量。

comments.en: //! F2 price snapshots and cost estimates: see the [pricing specification](../../../docs/design/desktop-usage/pricing.md)
comments.zh: //! F2 价格快照与费用估算（[价格规范](../../../docs/design/desktop-usage/pricing.md)、

comments.en: //! and [cost calculation rules](../../../docs/design/desktop-usage/data-contract.md#pricing).
comments.zh: //! [费用计算规则](../../../docs/design/desktop-usage/data-contract.md#pricing)）。

comments.en: //! Rates use hundredths of a minor currency unit per million tokens (i64; $0.075/M = 750).
comments.zh: //! 单位约定：价格 = 最小货币单位的百分之一 / 百万 token（i64，如 $0.075/M = 750）；

comments.en: //! Per-event components use round_half_up(tokens * rate / 100_000_000), with i128 arithmetic.
comments.zh: //! 单事件费用项以 i128 计算 round_half_up(token × 价格 / 100_000_000)，

comments.en: //! Also retain exact numerators so aggregate callers can sum before rounding; no binary floats.
comments.zh: //! 同时保留精确分子，供汇总时先累加后舍入；不使用二进制浮点。

comments.en: //! Unknown billing channels permit an unambiguous official API reference for the same model.
comments.zh: //! 实付渠道未知时，只使用同模型且无歧义的官方 API 参考价。

comments.en: //! Do not price reasoning twice, fill unknown tokens with zero, or price anomalous tokens.
comments.zh: //! 推理子集不与输出重复计价；未知 token 不补零；异常 token 不参与计价。

comments.en: /// Repository seed snapshot maintained with releases; imports skip duplicates in storage::pricing.
comments.zh: /// 仓库随版本维护的种子快照（种子导入幂等，见 [`crate::storage::pricing`]）。

comments.zh: /// 币种枚举（种子与本程序当前核验范围；新币种需先核验对应价格资料再扩展）。

comments.en: /// Service tiers; automatic estimation selects standard without mixing batch/flex/fast rows.
comments.zh: /// 服务档位（估算只自动匹配 standard；batch/flex/fast 行不串用）。

comments.en: /// Cache-write TTL tiers in minutes.
comments.zh: /// 缓存写 TTL 档（分钟）。

comments.zh: /// 金额换算分母：token × 价格(百分之一最小单位/Mtok) → 最小货币单位。

comments.zh: /// 快照 JSON 文件（种子与用户手工导入同格式）。

comments.zh: /// 来源类型：seed、manual 或 community。

comments.zh: /// 为 true，manual 为 false）。

comments.zh: /// 解析后的快照（进入存储层前的运行时形态）。

comments.zh: /// NULL 阈值归一为 0。

comments.zh: /// 半开 [from, to)；to None = 仍有效。

comments.zh: /// 官方供应商按量价标记：无精确匹配时的回退候选池（pricing.md 在线刷新设计）。

comments.en: /// Convert an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to UTC midnight milliseconds.
comments.zh: /// ISO 日期（YYYY-MM-DD）→ UTC 零点毫秒。

comments.zh: /// FNV-1a 内容哈希（跨版本稳定；用于同快照幂等导入判定）。

comments.zh: /// 内容哈希十六进制表示（TEXT 存储形态）。

comments.zh: /// 校验并归一化快照：格式标记、币种/档位枚举、非负价格、生效区间合法、

comments.zh: /// 同键区间不重叠、行内 price_id 唯一。

comments.zh: // 同键区间不重叠（半开 [from, to)；to None 视为 +∞，其后不得再有同键行）。

comments.en: // Content changes require a new snapshot ID for A10 duplicate import checks.
comments.zh: // 内容哈希：修正必须换快照 ID（A10 幂等导入的前提）。

comments.zh: // 估算引擎（纯函数）
